name: NationBuilder
description: NationBuilder is an organizing and community platform for people, fundraising, advocacy, events, memberships, websites, petitions, paths, surveys and voter engagement.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact nation through Relay-owned OAuth with PKCE and rotating V2 tokens, then run all 190 current official V2 operations through pinned routes. Safe runs 82 reads directly and requires approval for 108 mutations.

providerSetup.blocker: Live acceptance requires NationBuilder Certified Developer access or an eligible Enterprise/Network nation, a registered Relay OAuth app, exact Railway callback configuration, V2 token migration and representative nation data.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized owner completes certification and app registration, configures the Railway-held client pair and callback, then validates exact-nation authorization, rotating refresh, reads, approved reversible mutations, disconnect and post-disconnect denial in Railway staging.

evidence.supports: The official released OpenAPI reference documents 190 V2 JSON:API operations: 82 GET reads and 108 POST, PATCH or DELETE mutations.
NationBuilder documents nation-subdomain OAuth authorization code, optional PKCE, 24-hour V2 access tokens and single-use rotating refresh tokens.
Current V2 endpoints require current OAuth tokens and production applications must implement refresh before migration.
